about: Oshawa is on Lake Ontario east of Toronto, in Durham Region. It is a historic General Motors auto city with a downtown inland from the harbour. Ontario Tech University and Durham College occupy a north-end campus. About 175,000 people live in Oshawa.
seoSummary: Durham Region auto city on Lake Ontario, east of Toronto.
knownFor: General Motors assembly and auto-parts history
Lake Ontario harbour and waterfront trail
Eastern GTA industrial and commuter city
